explanation: This solution uses WP_HTML_Tag_Processor to scan through the HTML document linearly, finding all A tags. For each A tag, it checks if an href attribute is present using get_attribute() (which returns null only when the attribute is absent). When href is present—whether with a value, empty, or as a boolean—the target attribute is set to "_blank" using set_attribute(). Finally, get_updated_html() returns the modified HTML with all changes applied while preserving every other byte exactly.
